title: Merrill Lynch supports Five Acres Permanency Campaign
description: Five Acres supporter and LA Complex Director for Merrill Lynch Wealth Management, David Hunt tells us in this video, why Boy 5A is an important campaign, to the firm. For more information on Boy 5A visit www.5acres.org/advocacy-now

asr.full_text: Hi there, I work for Merrill Lynch Bank of America. My name is David Hunt and I'm the director to all the Merrill Lynch offices here in Los Angeles. And we are here today to talk about Boy 5A from Five Acres. This is a very special initiative that we're very proud of Bank of America Merrill Lynch to support. If you've known anything about Five Acres, they started in 1988, so over 100 years dedicated to helping young people live in productive, safe environments. As a matter of fact their goal and mission is really to help kids in the foster care program to live productive lives and there's seven statues throughout Los Angeles that represent the seven stages that unfortunately many of these kids get challenged with and be in 7 different homes during their foster care. Now, at Merrill Lynch we've been dedicated to making financial lives better for over 100 years, and we are committed as one of our core values to continue to do the great community service like this for our communities. So, thank you for your participation, and hopefully you can support this wonderful initiative.
